mapper.insert: INSERT INTO personal_record_capture_source (record_id, capture_id) VALUES (#{recordId}, CAST(#{captureId} AS UUID))
mapper.select: SELECT source.capture_id::text FROM personal_record_capture_source source JOIN capture_item capture ON capture.capture_id = source.capture_id WHERE source.record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY capture.captured_at ASC, source.capture_id ASC
